D3 ruling rule G13, for P12 and P22, written before their lines are ruled. P12 is shown when a concept shows members recording what happened to their work or the canvas: saving or asking for screenshots, timelapses or images of the work; reporting its fate (gone, survived, stood at the end, where it ended); mourning a loss; imagining what it would have been; atlas entries; marking the end. A progress report during building, a call, or a celebration that only cheers does not show P12 (they may show T4-007's state-posting, P01 or A07). P22 is shown only by a concept after placement ended (hour 73) in which members contest which version of the canvas or event is kept: asking a cleanup of a shared copy to fix their work, taking part in it, arguing that damage should stay as history, or correcting accounts that describe their group wrongly. Recording alone after the close is P12, not P22; editing a copy is P22 only where the version kept is at stake. Under G2 an absent line is rejected when its concepts show the element. Draws: P12 instantiate i at verb offset 170+i (170 to 870); P22 instantiate i at 546+i (546, 646)

The handler tabulates ruling shares per leg and op as a prompt to look. Doing (1) now, before the P22 absent rulings; (2) is carried for D3a-10; (3) applies at once to G13

Re-oriented after the compaction, as J asked: read handback-C5.md (the model before D3: after hour 73 the room records the work and decides what to keep; the arguing part tentative, P22) and the diary naming P22 (C4a entry from the field: firm on public exchanges, provisional on negotiating the legitimate version; support AMD/c0435, SquareSpiral/c0217, strangerthings/c0145), then the current model: history since D3 holds moves 172 (R01) and 173 (P05) only; P12 and P22 stand as served. The leg stands at P22: restrict, add-condition, add-step, link and instantiate ruled (261 lines); absent (521) read whole, not yet ruled; P12 not yet begun

Amendment G13a (2026-10-16, D3a-06), written after P22's lines other than absent were ruled and its 521 absent lines read whole, before they are ruled. Two clauses of G13 are made exact. (a) Correcting an account: P22 is shown where, after hour 73, a member corrects or disputes another member's or a visitor's account of the room's work, its conduct or the event, including the account a question presupposes ('why did the room do nothing?'); a question that asserts nothing, answered, and a member's own report are not corrections (P12). (b) The version kept and damage as history: P22 is shown where members set one version against another as the one that stands (the work before the damage against the end result, the damaged work against a cleaned or intended one), propose keeping the damaged version in the room's records or keepsakes (sidebar, logo, stickers, poster, artwork), or argue that the damage is the work's history (scars as history, the range's upper end). A fond or joking reading of a flaw that keeps nothing and sets no version against another marks the end (P12). It applies backwards to every P22 line ruled this leg; checked against it, one changes: starcraft-051 (restrict), from specification to an evidence limit, re-ruled as an appended line. P12's lines are ruled under G13 with G13a from the start
